map.：精氨酸+可乐定两种药物激发后，GH 最高峰值为 3.2 ng/mL（本中心切点: : After stimulation with two drugs, arginine and clonidine, the highest GH peak was 3.2 ng/mL (this centre's cut-off <5 ng/mL suggests deficiency, some adults use <3): combined with height velocity and low IGF-1 this supports GHD, and constitutional growth delay must be excluded.

map.单一激发敏感性不足且变异大，指南常要求两种不同机制药物（如精氨酸+可乐定或胰岛素: A single stimulation test has insufficient sensitivity and large variability, so guidelines usually require two drugs with different mechanisms (such as arginine plus clonidine, or insulin hypoglycaemia) both to be low before diagnosing, which reduces false positives.
map.与 GH 检测试剂（免疫法 vs 化学发光）、年龄及性别有关，须使用本实验室参考: It depends on the GH assay reagent (immunoassay vs chemiluminescence), age and sex, so the reference cut-off of your own laboratory must be used.
